Title: Confirmation needed about: Phased Motion Detector

Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

Can you confirm me that "During an action" in that card text allow me to use that +1 intecept effect only once each action, please?

Card Text:
Phased Motion Detector (equipment)
During an action, if a vampire plays an action modifier card requiring Chimerstry, Obfuscate or Obtenebration, the bearer gets +1 intercept, even if intercept is not yet needed.

Thanks in advance,
Rémi.
